case.summary: Case CASE-010 (Card SC-03010-K950): The case was triggered by a real-time risk score of 0.89 on transaction 4012172 ($269.17, domestic) [EV-b19b39d7]. Investigation revealed the transaction originated from a new device (Samsung SM-G973F) and an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-8f5f7230, EV-24c7ce5c]. The card (SC-03010-K950) showed 3 online transactions within 48 hours, deviating from its historical average of $187.89 over 2 prior transactions [EV-f6b14e0b, EV-6ce8f299]. The device profile was linked to one prior confirmed fraud case, and the customer had one previous fraud case (CC-4321) [EV-5d0c0ebd, EV-10ecd46f]. The customer confirmed they did not authorize the purchases and retained physical possession of the card [EV-4aebde84]. Pattern analysis retrieved 6 prior cases matching 'card_not_present_new_device' [EV-0191e171].
